resolved_conflicts.field: identity of the Hobbs Hill name
resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register lists the site as Tracy City at 2,125 ft. Tennessee Landforms lists Hobbs Hill at 2,132 ft in Grundy County. The two are close, but no source says outright that they are one tower. The story keeps the names separate and says so.

The marker's coordinates (35 15.095 N, 85 45.18 W) differ from the register's (35 16.680 N, 85 44.064 W). The marker may describe a different CCC fire tower, so the story does not link it to this site.

Forest Lookouts and Tennessee Landforms mark a Hobbs Hill tower removed with no date. No source says that tower is the register's tower, and the 2006 visit found the register tower standing. Status is set to 'unknown' rather than the brief's 'gone'.

notes_for_editor: The brief's other name 'Hobbs Hill' is not confirmed as the same tower: the register entry is 'Tracy City', and the Hobbs Hill entries are on Forest Lookouts and Tennessee Landforms, both marked removed. The elevations are close (2,125 vs 2,132 ft) and both are in Grundy County. The marker (hmdb 276949) describes a CCC Company 1475 fire tower at Camp S-67 in Tracy City, whose coordinates differ from the register's; it may be a different tower. No build date, builder, staffing or fire record found for the register tower. The Hobbs' Hill community history was read and has no tower content. A Grundy County historic resources multiple-property form (npgallery b219985b) turned up in search but was not read, to stay in budget. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 6 page reads.
